We are recruiting a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the UCL Interaction Centre (UCLIC) to join XR-SENSE, a major EU Horizon-funded project developing next-generation immersive and inclusive XR technologies.

The successful candidate will conduct research on multimodal affect recognition and modelling, combining machine learning, computer vision, physiological sensing, and human-participant studies to enable personalised XR experiences.

We are looking for candidates with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Affective Computing, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related field, with experience in multimodal data analysis and affect recognition.

Position: Full-time, 2-year appointment Start date: November 2026 or soon after Location: UCL, London

Contact person: Nadia Berthouze (n.berthouze@ucl.ac.uk)

The position offers exciting opportunities for international collaboration, high-impact publications, and engagement with leading European research and industry partners.
